description: This file defines the 'Order' class within the OpenCart project's Catalog Model Checkout namespace. It contains methods for managing orders such as adding, editing, retrieving, and deleting orders, along with associated actions like updating order status, comments, transaction IDs, and handling related products, vouchers, totals, histories, and transactions.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents the Order model class responsible for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting order data within the OpenCart system. It handles complex operations including managing associated products, vouchers, totals, histories, and related transactions.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Inserts a new order record into the database with provided order data, then adds related products, vouchers, and totals.

methods.name: editOrder
methods.description: Updates an existing order record with new data and manages associated products, vouchers, and totals accordingly.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Removes an order from the database and deletes associated products, vouchers, totals, histories, transactions, and rewards, also voids the order before deletion.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of an order by its ID, including related country and zone data, and decodes custom fields.

methods.name: editTransactionId
methods.description: Updates the transaction ID for a specific order.

methods.name: editOrderStatusId
methods.description: Updates the status ID of an existing order.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Adds or updates a comment associated with an order.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Inserts a new product into an order, adds options and subscriptions if applicable, then returns the new product ID.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes one or all products from an order, along with associated options, subscriptions, vouchers, and other related data.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific product in an order by product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option for a specific product in an order.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes options for a specific product in an order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific product in an order.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription entry for a product within an order.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription from an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription record.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getVoucherByVoucherId
methods.description: Fetches a voucher record based on voucher ID for a specific order.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Retrieves all vouchers linked with an order.

methods.name: addVoucher
methods.description: Creates a new voucher record for an order.

methods.name: deleteVouchers
methods.description: Deletes voucher(s) associated with an order.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Retrieves all vouchers linked with a specific order based on the provided order ID.

methods.name: addTotal
methods.description: Inserts a new total entry for a given order into the database.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Removes all total records associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Fetches all total records for a specific order, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds an order status change history record, optionally notifying the customer and overriding existing statuses.

methods.name: deleteHistory
methods.description: Deletes all history records for a specific order.
